extension.description: Git tools suite: generate a commit message for selected files into the Source Control input box, and exclude files/folders from version control (git rm --cached, optionally add to .gitignore).
command.generateCommit: Generate Commit Message for Selected Files
config.language.description: Language of the generated commit message.
config.provider.description: AI provider used to generate commit messages.
config.provider.enum.openai: OpenAI and compatible services (Zhipu, DeepSeek, local models, etc.)
config.autoStageSelectedFiles.descriptio: Automatically stage the selected files before generating, so committing includes only those files.
config.userAgent.description: Custom User-Agent header sent with API requests. Leave empty to use the default.
config.openai.model.description: Model id used for OpenAI requests.
config.openai.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens for the OpenAI response.
config.anthropic.model.description: Model id used for Anthropic requests.
config.anthropic.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens for the Anthropic response.
config.git.untrackedFileMaxBytes.descrip: Skip inlining the content of untracked files larger than this many bytes (0 = no limit).
